tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Find verified SMBs (salons, plumbers, consultants, etc.) in a given area that can execute a requested service. Returns only transactable businesses in our supply network.

tools.name: verify_business
tools.description: Confirm an SMB is real, currently operating, and capable of a specific service. Use before booking if you have an unverified SMB ID.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message across SMS, email, or voice on behalf of an agent's user or an SMB. Five message types: transactional, marketing, reminder, follow_up, notification. Compliance gate enforces TCPA / GDPR / CASL / PDPL consent at runtime — marketing without recorded consent is rejected with a compliance_violation receipt.

message_type.description: 'marketing' requires a consent_record_id; the gate verifies and rejects if missing.

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Intake a prospect into an SMB's pipeline with deduplication and CRM integration.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Book, reschedule, or cancel appointments with an SMB. Async — returns pending_async immediately; final outcome delivered via webhook or pollable via get_status.

tools.name: send_transactional_confirmation
tools.description: Send OTPs, booking confirmations, payment receipts, or cancellation notices. Idempotent — safe to retry.

tools.name: handle_inbound
tools.description: Classify and route inbound messages (SMS replies, emails, voicemails, contact forms) on behalf of an SMB. Returns classified intent and suggested next action.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand off a failed or ambiguous task to a human operator with full context bundle. Use only after automated resolution has failed.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check the current state of an async operation. Poll no more than once per 10 seconds; prefer webhook callbacks for real-time updates.

tools.name: get_outcome
tools.description: Retrieve the final OutcomeReceipt (with cost and reason codes) for a completed operation.

tools.name: preview_cost
tools.description: Get estimated cost, latency, and success probability for a planned operation BEFORE executing it. Actual cost guaranteed within ±5% of preview.

tools.name: self_test
tools.description: Verify the service is healthy and all claimed capabilities are working. Call at startup or after unexpected errors. Free — no cost.
